edges.subject: GRN
edges.quote: Mutation in the GRN gene, encoding the progranulin (PGRN) protein, shows a dose-dependent disease correlation, wherein haploinsufficiency results in frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD)

edges.subject: GRN
edges.quote: complete loss results in neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (NCL)

edges.subject: PGRN
edges.quote: it has been increasingly implicated in lysosomal physiology

edges.subject: PGRN
edges.quote: PGRN interacts with the lysosomal enzyme, glucocerebrosidase (GCase), and is essential for proper GCase activity

edges.subject: frontotemporal lobar degeneration
edges.quote: reduced lysosomal hydrolase activity may be a pathological mechanism in cases of GRN-related FTLD and NCL
